steps.text: Add {frap_roast} pumps of frap roast to the cup
Fill the cup with {milk} to the bottom line
Pour the cup contents into the blender pitcher
Add a level scoop of ice to the pitcher
Add {frap_base} pumps of frap base to the pitcher
Add {dark_caramel} pumps of dark caramel to the pitcher
Add {pumps} pumps of {flavor} to the pitcher
Add a layer of whipped cream to the bottom of the cup
Top the whipped cream with caramel crunch topping
Pour the blended mixture into the cup
